title: WMS AI Copilot - Warehouse Management AI Assistant
description: Full-stack, real-time AI copilot for warehouse management built with Next.js, Express, Supabase, and the Vercel AI SDK, featuring streaming natural-language queries and an adaptive dashboard.
longDescription: Architected and built a full-stack, production-shaped monorepo for a real-time AI copilot designed for modern warehouse management. Built for my portfolio instead of a formal job position, the platform lets warehouse admins run natural-language queries for stock levels, top sellers, and reorder alerts, returning token-by-token streaming answers or sortable data grids. Integrated Vercel AI SDK and Groq Cloud (Llama 3.x) for low-latency, deterministic tool-calling against curated, strictly typed database tools rather than raw query execution, keeping the LLM inside tight security and trust boundaries. Built a full operational split-view dashboard in Next.js App Router for real-time inventory, product, and order history tracking, and architected the app from the ground up with next-intl for fully bilingual (English/Spanish) conversational and UI flows. Structured as an npm workspaces monorepo with strict TypeScript typing across API, frontend, and AI tool definitions, backed by Jest test coverage.

features.title: Adaptive Visualization Pipeline
features.description: An intelligent frontend engine dynamically renders plain text, charts, or sortable TanStack tables based on the schema of the AI's query result — shown here answering a natural-language request with a live pie chart and category breakdown.

features.title: Sortable Data Grids
features.description: For tabular results, the copilot streams structured data straight into a sortable TanStack Table, letting admins reorder and scan inventory results without leaving the conversation.

title: La Montre - E-commerce Site
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform built with Next.js, a NestJS (Node.js) API, and PostgreSQL, featuring a product catalog and shopping cart
longDescription: A full-stack e-commerce website for a watch brand, pairing a Next.js front-end with a NestJS (Node.js) REST API and a PostgreSQL database for product catalog and order data. Features a clean product catalog with filtering and a fully functional shopping cart, styled with Tailwind CSS. Responsive design ensures a polished experience across all devices. Demonstrates proficiency in Next.js App Router, building and consuming a NestJS API, relational data modeling with PostgreSQL, and utility-first styling with Tailwind CSS.

features.title: Supabase PostgreSQL Database
features.description: A relational schema hosted on Supabase PostgreSQL: the Watch table stores each product's model, price, and digital/smart flags, and links to the Brand table through a brandId foreign key. Prisma manages schema migrations against the database.

title: Mologrind Studios - Indie Game Studio Landing Page
description: Indie game studio landing page built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, featuring a dark atmospheric design, multi-section storytelling layout, and full English/Spanish internationalization with a live language switcher.
longDescription: A moody, brand-forward landing page for Mologrind Studios — an indie game development studio — built with Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4. The site presents the studio's identity across seven sections: hero, about, projects showcase, vision, and contact, all tied together with a cohesive dark theme using an OKLCH color palette and Cormorant Garamond serif typography. Internationalization is handled via next-intl, delivering full English and Spanish versions with a one-click language switcher baked into the header — no page reload required. Sections animate into view on scroll using an IntersectionObserver-powered Reveal system, and the entire site is statically generated at build time for instant load performance. Demonstrates proficiency in Next.js App Router with SSG, Tailwind CSS v4 utility-first design, next-intl i18n routing, server and client component architecture, and building polished, brand-driven marketing sites.

title: EthRewards Dashboard
description: Interactive D3.js dashboard visualizing Ethereum block rewards in USD with Redux state management and real-time blockchain data
longDescription: A React application showcasing advanced data visualization capabilities with D3.js. Built in a weekend as a technical challenge, this project enables users to analyze Ethereum blockchain economics through interactive charts displaying block rewards converted to USD. Features Redux for global state management, Material UI components for a polished interface, and integration with CoinGecko API for real-time market data. Demonstrates proficiency in data visualization, state management patterns, API integration, and rapid prototyping. Includes comprehensive testing with Vitest.

title: Cookbook API - GraphQL with Node.js and TypeScript
description: Type-safe GraphQL API for managing cookbook data and recipes built with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript
longDescription: A robust Node.js API implementing GraphQL for efficient recipe and cookbook data management. Features Express.js web framework integration and comprehensive TypeScript support for type-safe, maintainable code. Designed with modern API architecture patterns including proper error handling, validation, and scalable data structures. Demonstrates backend development expertise, GraphQL schema design, and API best practices for building production-ready services.

features.title: GraphQL Playground
features.description: An interactive GraphQL Playground for querying the API, shown here running an ingredients query that returns the full list of ingredient names stored in the database.

title: QuestLog - Game Backlog Tracker
description: Game backlog tracker built with .NET Blazor and PostgreSQL, featuring user authentication, per-user libraries, and full CRUD status and rating tracking.
longDescription: QuestLog is a full-stack game backlog tracker built with .NET Blazor and a PostgreSQL database. Users create secure accounts to search a global game catalog via the RAWG API and add titles to a private, per-user shelf, where they can track status (Wishlist, Backlog, Playing, Completed, Shelved), rate games, and add personal notes. Full CRUD functionality lets users add, update, and remove games, with authentication and authorization ensuring each user only accesses their own data. Demonstrates proficiency in .NET Blazor, relational database design with PostgreSQL, user authentication, and third-party API integration.

features.title: Full CRUD on Shelf Entries
features.description: Every game on a user's shelf is fully customizable — users can add games, update their status, rating, and notes, and remove entries entirely, all scoped to their own account.

title: Inglés con Ailu - Language Coaching Website
description: Professional English language coaching website with SASS, Bootstrap, and custom Figma design for scheduling and student resources
longDescription: A comprehensive website for an English language teacher featuring instructor profiles, service information, and student resources. Designed from scratch using Figma for wireframing, mockups, and interaction design, then built using SASS preprocessor and Bootstrap framework for a responsive, mobile-friendly experience. Includes downloadable practice materials, integrated class booking system, and contact functionality. Demonstrates full-stack design and development process from concept to implementation, with focus on user experience and accessibility.

features.title: Figma Design System
features.description: The full site was designed from scratch in Figma, using reusable Figma components to build out both desktop and mobile layouts before implementation.
